description: Versioned reviewed command-operation and controlled regex-fallback mappings to ATT&CK techniques. These are deterministic command-level mappings; SecureBERT remains the audit/fallback classifier for commands outside reviewed policy coverage.
limitations: Structural rules cover only closed parser operations; controlled regex fallbacks can miss command variants not represented by reviewed patterns.
Rules are high-precision policy mappings, not full ATT&CK coverage.
Generated or externally sourced future rules must include provenance and review status before production activation.

basis: A read-only crontab listing is inspection of configured services/jobs, not creation, modification, persistence, or execution.
The structural parser must prove the list operation; a broad command regex is insufficient.
provenance.author: project developer

references.name: MITRE ATT&CK T1007 System Service Discovery

basis: Editing or installing a crontab is a scheduled-task modification operation.
The mapping does not claim that a task ran or persisted outside Cowrie.
